---
name: Bug report
about: Find an issue? Tell me about your problem!
title: "[BUG]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**What happened?**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**How did it happen?**
Determine the level and provide a detailed description of how to replicate the bug. This eliminates all uncertainty.

**What should happen?**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots and Videos**
If applicable, add screenshots or videos to help explain your problem.

**What did you use?**
Include what operating system (including version) you are using and, if applicable, what browser you are using.
